say:2:1910102002:1.text: Don't worry, I'll get you aboard safe and sound. The Heroic Order's already covered your fare, so just sit back and we'll be there soon.
say:2:1910102002:1.source_cn: 还是老样子，我会把你安安稳稳送上远航船。放心。那是艘途...
